data.narrative:
Hybron is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Brennan Lieu and Aaron Guo that has raised $30M to date. The valuation landscape includes one public comparable (277810.KQ) and eight private peers in robotics and manufacturing, including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Bedrock Robotics.

Due to insufficient clustering of same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier peers within the narrow robotics manufacturing segment, peer-median valuation methods cannot be reliably applied. A single datapoint was insufficient to establish a credible comparable set. Consequently, the analysis relies on stage-progression methodology, which applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement to the $30M raised proxy, yielding an implied valuation of $75M.

The triangulated range supportable by available methods is $64M (low) to $86M (high), with a median of $75M. This analysis reflects only one methodological input and should be treated as preliminary. Key uncertainties include: the absence of sufficient close peer valuations to calibrate the 2.5x multiplier against actual robotics sector dynamics, the representativeness of total raised as a valuation proxy, and capital efficiency metrics relative to the peer set. Resolution of these unknowns through expanded comparables or direct financial performance data would strengthen conviction in the range.
